_meta.purpose: Source of truth for backend/config/airportCities.json. Hand-maintained allow-list of real, currently-bookable destinations from Ben Gurion Airport (TLV), with the owner-approved Mexico connecting-service exception, NOT derived from the frozen-since-2014 OpenFlights routes.dat (see build-tlv-destinations.js for why that was rejected as the sole gate — it hid ~80 real current routes including Dubai, Lisbon and Tokyo while keeping dead ones).
_meta.method: For the original 82 entries, El Al's own live city-to-city sitemap (elal.com/flight-deals/en-il/sitemap/city-to-city-flights, 81 cities, current bookable TLV routes as crawled) was cross-checked against Wikipedia's List of El Al destinations and 2026 news coverage (AirlineGeeks, Times of Israel, JPost) for route status, plus Wizz Air's Sept 2026 TLV expansion (Times of Israel) for 3 non-El-Al additions (Cluj-Napoca, Vilnius, Bratislava). Those original 82 city names were verified resolvable against WeatherAPI.com's geocoding search endpoint (the provider backend/services/weatherService.js actually calls). See additions_2026_10_20 for the separate provenance of the 14 later entries.

additions_2026_10_20.selectionMethod: IAA 2025 annual report, accumulated passengers by first destination, printed pp. 16-21.
additions_2026_10_20.routeEvidence: Dated Google Flights, Trip.com, and Wizz Air pages accessed 2026-10-20 show nonstop service for the 10 non-Mexico cities.
additions_2026_10_20.climateSource: The three new profiles for Mexico City, Guadalajara, and Addis Ababa use Climates to Travel 1991-2020 normals.
additions_2026_10_20.connectingOnly: Mexico City, Cancun, Guadalajara, and Monterrey are CONNECTING-ONLY: no nonstop TLV service per sources accessed 2026-10-20; included as an owner-approved exception.

_meta.excluded: Moscow and Kyiv deliberately excluded despite appearing on some route lists: El Al suspended Russia service (confirmed June 2026, suspended until at least March 2027) and Ukraine routes have been suspended since Feb 2022. Both are stale sitemap remnants, not real bookable options. Sochi is separately included in additions_2026_10_20 because a currently sold nonstop is offered by non-El-Al carrier Red Wings (cited Trip.com page).
_meta.renamedFromSource: A few El Al labels were cleaned to a plain, geocodable city name: 'Fort Lauderdale, Miami Area' -> Fort Lauderdale; 'Heraklion (Crete)' -> Heraklion; 'Hong Kong (China)' -> Hong Kong; 'Patras-Peloponnese' -> Patras; 'Sardinia' (region) -> Cagliari (the actual airport city); 'Sicily' (region) -> Catania (the actual airport city); 'Sitia (Crete)' -> Sitia.
_meta.maintenance: Re-review periodically (airline route networks change every season). This file is the thing to edit; then run node backend/scripts/build-tlv-destinations.js to regenerate config/airportCities.json.
